title: One-Step Safe Segment
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic multi-tape Turing machine with Boolean work-tape symbols, let $a$ be a state, and let $c,d$ be configurations on the same input. If one step from $c$ produces $d$, and neither $c$ nor $d$ has state $a$, then the configuration after one step from $c$ is $d$, and the run from $c$ avoids state $a$ at steps $0$ and $1$.
hypotheses_covered: A distinguished state and two configurations on the same input
One step from c produces d
The state of c is not a
The state of d is not a
